# Payment

Course registration is confirmed after payment.

Each course costs **1500 DH**.

## Payment Options

You can pay using PayPal. Depending on availability, PayPal may also allow card payment.

| Course | Price | Payment |
|---|---:|---|
| Applied Biostatistics with R | 1500 DH | [Pay with PayPal](PAYPAL_LINK_TO_REPLACE) |
| Machine Learning with R | 1500 DH | [Pay with PayPal](PAYPAL_LINK_TO_REPLACE) |
| Survival Analysis for Clinical Research with R | 1500 DH | [Pay with PayPal](PAYPAL_LINK_TO_REPLACE) |
| Meta-Analysis with R | 1500 DH | [Pay with PayPal](PAYPAL_LINK_TO_REPLACE) |

## After Payment

After payment, participants should receive a confirmation email with:

- course name;
- payment confirmation;
- next steps;
- communication channel invitation;
- course start date;
- support contact.

If payment and pre-registration use different email addresses, please mention this on the pre-registration form or contact page.
